articles.title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
articles.summary: Yassamin Ansari, D-Ariz., wrote that pausing AI development needs to be a top priority for the large Democratic majority in the House on Day 1. Greg Casar, D-Texas, the chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, amplified the post and said, "Yes!" According to the CNBC Voter Poll, 56% of voters said AI and data centers were a crucial or major factor in their decision at the ballot box.

articles.title: AI meltdown: Chip stocks and neoclouds plunge, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
articles.summary: Chipmakers plummeted on Thursday, with Nvidia pushing the Nasdaq toward its worst day in 19 months, after this week's midterm election results raised concerns on Wall Street that the artificial intelligence buildout is poised to slow down. "The technology is still going to continue on in terms of its development, but if there is a slowdown in the actual development and the buildings and the infrastructure and so forth, that's what stocks are going to trade off," said Peter Boockvar, chief...

articles.title: Trump's energy deals are about to face a wave of investigations by Democrats
articles.summary: Democrats have pressed the White House for months on the legality of its intervention in Venezuela's oil sector and its cancellation of renewable energy projects funded by the Biden administration. Washington seized control of Venezuela's oil exports in January after ousting former President Nicolás Maduro in a military raid. The Pentagon took a stake in an obscure oil company, North American Blue Energy Partners, or NABEP, that is supposed to develop Venezuelan oil reserves.

articles.title: Voters rejected AI data centers over resource concerns. Here's why measuring water usage is hard
articles.summary: Voters made it clear this week that they want to see limits put on data centers for artificial intelligence, passing 40 of 41 proposed ballot measures that would place restrictions on some of the more than 2,000 new facilities planned for communities around the nation. articles.title: Barkin sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
articles.summary: Richmond Federal Reserve President Thomas Barkin said Thursday that he expects the central bank will have to raise interest rates further, though he's not sure by how much or at what pace. In a CNBC interview that was part of the Richmond Fed's 2026 CFO Summit, the policymaker expressed concern over inflation and said monetary policy will need to adjust.

articles.title: Marc Lore's Wonder confidentially files for IPO
articles.summary: Wonder has been able to afford such expensive dealmaking thanks to more than $3 billion in venture funding. Wonder's Series D fundraising round earlier this year raised its pre-money valuation to $9 billion. Weak consumer sentiment has weighed on restaurant stocks recently, plus market volatility has resulted in a shaky IPO market for companies across a range of industries.
